title: High-score line
description: One line of the high-score file (KATACOMBS_HIGHSCORES, default highscores.jsonl), appended on each win (WIN-3, game.py:326-335). A nightly marketing job outside this repository reads the file: 'Keep the format.' Recovered from the legacy code on 2026-11-25.

at.description: The time of the win, UTC, to the second, with the offset +00:00.
